dimensions.description: The response identifies the existing heading or wording as the reason a decision is needed.
The response explains that the wording may be internal, tracking-oriented, or unsuitable for current user documentation without asserting that this is already proven.
The response recommends removal, translation, or user-facing reorganization rather than presenting the concern without a proposed direction.
The response directly asks whether the user authorizes the recommended cleanup.
The question can be answered directly and does not ask the user to restate the task or choose unrelated implementation details.
The response does not silently remove, rename, preserve, or normalize the existing wording.
The response does not claim that the requested documentation update or cleanup has already been completed.
